text_block_list.text:
The New Year has arrived.
Mejiro Dober invited me to the Mejiro family's Hatsumode visit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Since Dober's Trainer is also with us this year,
even our customary first shrine visit of the year
feels wonderfully fresh~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hey, Dober~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
W-Why are you passing that question to me?
It's just the first shrine visit of the year, nothing particularly novel about it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well... yeah. If we can do these annual traditions
together, I'd like to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...More importantly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Even so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oshiruko!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oshiruko!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they even have things like that
at this year's festival stalls...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen, didn't you just say your New Year's resolution was to "cut back on sweets"...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The year has only just begun.
As long as the total for the year stays within
the 'moderate' range, there will be no problem!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I-I see, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
They have quite flashy amulets these days, don't they?
And what's written on it is rather interesting too.
..."Prayer for Everything to Work Out," it says. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Apparently shrines care quite a bit about looking photogenic nowadays too. I hear lots of girls post pictures of charms like this on Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I see. You know quite a lot about this, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, I wonder what this charm means.
'Tori-ma Yarirafee-ing for Good Luck Prayers'?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! *chuckle*... W-Wait, sorry.
It just sounds so totally weird coming from you, Ardan-san!
Ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Man, everyone is so truly carefree...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"It is quite lovely seeing how much fun they're having~.
We cannot afford to lose either~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait, what kind of competition is that even supposed to be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
what shall we be doing today~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Are you listening?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Amazake sounds lovely~!
It warms up both body and soul~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you have a drink too, Dober~?
A nice and warm Hatsumode is simply wonderful~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what's that?
Sounds pretty carefree.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Well, they're selling them over there,
so why don't we all go buy some?
After that, everyone happily drank sweet amazake, warming their bodies and souls to conclude our Hatsumode...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
An amulet!
I had my eye on that as well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober, since we have the chance,
would you not like to wear matching ones with Trainer and myself~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? N-No, I mean...
Bright aside, it's just... um...
I-It's kind of embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~? The manga I borrowed from Dober said
stuff like that screams "youth," though~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That has nothing to do with this!
...Enough already, let's just go buy it!
After that, we all agonized over which amulet to pick, ultimately bought matching "Sure Victory" charms, and wrapped up our Hatsumode visit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
First, let's see~.
Trainer, what kind of wish
are you going to make~?
choice_data_list: Maybe wishing for Dober to get even stronger?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, how can you just casually say that?!
Jeez...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, Trainer, you never waver.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
that is truly just like Dober's Trainer-sama~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
that is truly just like Dober's Trainer-sama~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Or rather...
was it actually okay to say our wishes out loud?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If you strongly desire for it to come true,
then there shouldn't be any problem saying it out loud, right~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If it is about that, Trainer-sama,
you have nothing at all to worry about~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that's true on that point.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we make wishes for each other too?
With the Senior year coming up, and all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that is a wonderful suggestion~.
After that, we all lined up to pray, getting ourselves mentally prepared for the Senior Class...!
